per_depth.shortcut_name: Steiner routing through intermediate support platforms
per_depth.common_affordance: Allowing arbitrary non-terminal platforms to serve as intermediate shared routing vertices
The problem is a Steiner tree problem with at most ten terminals: non-primary platforms may be shared intermediate junctions, and the terminal set is small enough for 2^t subset DP.
The intrinsic undirected connectivity requirement for all listed primary turbines, combined with the immutable bound of at most ten terminals, permits exact subset-mask Steiner-tree DP.
